name: Ronzoni Angel Hair Capellini (With Olive Oil & Sea Salt)
whyItWorks: Extremely delicate, ultra-thin strands of enriched semolina pasta that soften completely in minutes. Minimal chewing required, passing smoothly through the digestive tract with zero rough edges.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil for 4–5 minutes until soft. Drain and toss immediately with extra virgin olive oil, sea salt, and a pinch of aged grated parmesan.
